objects.taxonomy_description: Elongated bicycle with two seats and two sets of pedals arranged in tandem (one behind the other). The frame is significantly longer than a standard bicycle (approximately 2 meters), with an extended top tube connecting the front and rear triangles. Two handlebars are present: the front rider steers, the rear rider has fixed or adjustable handlebars. Both riders have individual saddles positioned at different heights along the frame. The wheels are standard bicycle size (26-28 inches). The overall silhouette is a stretched bicycle profile with two distinct rider positions.

objects.taxonomy_description: Composite flower with a central yellow disc surrounded by a single whorl of white ray petals (florets). The flower head measures 2-5 cm in diameter with 13-34 elongated white petals radiating outward from the bright yellow center. The petals are narrow, slightly pointed, and arranged in a flat, circular pattern. The flower is supported by a slender green stem with small alternate leaves. The center disc has a bumpy, granular texture from individual disc florets.

objects.taxonomy_description: Brass wind instrument with compact conical tubing coiled into oval shape. Length approximately 33 cm. Bell flares to 11-12 cm diameter, facing forward. Three piston valves arranged vertically on top with mother-of-pearl or plastic finger buttons. Mouthpiece is cup-shaped, detachable, inserted into leadpipe. Body surface is lacquered brass (golden-yellow) or silver-plated (bright white-metal). Tubing diameter gradually increases from mouthpiece to bell. Valve casings are cylindrical with visible seam lines. Bell rim is rolled edge. Finger hooks and thumb ring present for grip.
